business_summary: Yamashin-Filter Corp. operates as a filter manufacturer in Japan, Asia, the United States of America, Europe, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Construction Machinery Filter Business and Air Filter Business. The company manufactures, develops, and sells filters for construction and agricultural machines, drive-trains, fuel systems and various filter products for industrial and precision machines, and industrial filter related parts; and nano filter products. Its construction machinery filters, including hydraulic fluid filters to protect hydraulic equipment, such as cylinders; engine oil filters that are used in various types of engines to filter fine dust in engine oil; fuel filters used to construction machinery to remove dust and moisture contained in fuel for diesel engines; transmission filters for transmission mechanisms such as bulldozers and wheel loaders; industrial filters to filter hydraulic and lubricating oils, and other liquids in a range of industrial machinery; and process filters, which are used for filtration and separation in manufacturing processes across a range of industries, including electronic parts, precision components, LCD displays, and food products. The company also provides various types of air filters for a range of settings, such as office buildings, factories, equipment, and vehicles; and medical-grade masks and replacement inner sheets that are made using YAMASHIN NANO FILTER. The company was formerly known as Yamashin Industry Inc. and changed its name to Yamashin-Filter Corp. in October 2005. Yamashin-Filter Corp. was incorporated in 1956 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Yamashin-Filter Corp.은 일본, 아시아, 미국, 유럽 및 국제적으로 필터 제조업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 건설기계 필터 사업과 공기 필터 사업의 두 부문으로 운영됩니다. 회사는 건설기계 및 농업기계용 필터, 드라이브트레인, 연료시스템, 산업용 및 정밀기계용 각종 필터제품, 산업용 필터 관련 부품을 제조, 개발, 판매하고 있습니다. 나노필터 제품 등이 있습니다. 실린더와 같은 유압 장비를 보호하기 위한 작동유 필터를 포함한 건설 기계 필터; 각종 엔진에 사용되어 엔진오일 중의 미세먼지를 걸러내는 엔진오일필터; 디젤 엔진 연료에 포함된 먼지와 수분을 제거하기 위해 건설 기계에 사용되는 연료 필터; 불도저, 휠로더 등의 변속기 기구용 변속기 필터; 다양한 산업 기계의 유압유, 윤활유 및 기타 액체를 필터링하는 산업용 필터; 전자부품, 정밀부품, LCD 디스플레이, 디스플레이 등 다양한 산업분야의 제조공정에서 여과 및 분리에 사용되는 공정필터 등이 있습니다.
